hook.say: Hungry? Five tasty questions about Turkish food and drink. The last ingredient will surprise you!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which salty Turkish drink is made from yogurt and water?
questions.say: Which salty Turkish drink is made from yogurt and water?
questions.fact: Ayran is simply yogurt, water and a pinch of salt.
questions.sayAnswer: Eye-ran! It is simply yogurt, water and a pinch of salt.

questions.q: Which city is Türkiye's baklava capital?
questions.say: Which city is Turkey's baklava capital?
questions.fact: Antep baklava won protected status from the EU in 2013.
questions.sayAnswer: Gazi-antep! Its pistachio baklava won protected status from the European Union in 2013.

questions.q: Türkiye is the world's top producer of which nut?
questions.say: Turkey is the world's top producer of which nut?
questions.fact: In 2023 Türkiye grew more than half of the world's hazelnuts.
questions.sayAnswer: Hazelnuts! In 2023, Turkey grew more than half of the world's hazelnuts.

questions.q: "Kahvaltı", the Turkish word for breakfast, literally means what?
questions.say: Kah-val-tuh, the Turkish word for breakfast, literally means what?
questions.fact: Yet the star drink of a Turkish breakfast is black tea.
questions.sayAnswer: Before coffee! And yet the star drink of a Turkish breakfast is black tea.

questions.q: Stretchy Maraş ice cream is thickened with salep. What is salep made from?
questions.say: Stretchy Marash ice cream is thickened with salep. What is salep made from?
questions.fact: Salep is a flour ground from the tubers of wild orchids.
questions.sayAnswer: Orchid tubers! Salep is a flour ground from the tubers of wild orchids.
